values.heading: Signs Your Truck Needs an Overhaul
values.body: Recognizing when your truck needs an engine overhaul can save you from unexpected breakdowns and costly repairs. Heavy truck financing can help to assess these issues timely and smartly. Here are some common signs to watch for:

cards.text: Increased Oil Consumption: Worn valve guides or seals can cause excessive oil use.
Excessive Exhaust: Thick, dark smoke from the tailpipe indicates engine issues.
Colored Exhaust: Blue, black, or white smoke can signal different engine problems.
Water in the Oil: Foam or sludge on the oil cap or dipstick means water contamination.
Engine Knocking: Unusual knocking sounds suggest internal engine damage.
Oil Pressure Gauge Issues: Significant changes in oil pressure readings can indicate problems.
Sludge: Sludge on the oil pin signifies inefficient oil or coolant usage.
Overheating Oil: The burning oil smell points to overheating issues.
Reduced Acceleration: Loss of power indicates cylinder compression loss.
Low Fuel Economy: Poor engine performance leads to higher fuel consumption.
Low Oil Pressure: Worn bearings or a faulty oil pump can cause low pressure.
